# Voyage AI by MongoDB

> Use Voyage AI's best-in-class embedding models and rerankers to power your AI search and retrieval applications.

- [Accessing Voyage AI Models](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/api-and-clients.md)
- [Embedding and Reranking API Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/api-reference/overview.md): Use the Embedding and Reranking API to access Voyage AI embedding and reranking models.
- [Voyage AI by MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/index.md): Use Voyage AI's best-in-class embedding models and rerankers to power your AI search and retrieval applications.
- [Model API Keys](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/api-keys.md): Use the Atlas UI to create and manage API keys for accessing Voyage AI models.
- [Deploy Voyage AI Models Using AWS Marketplace](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/aws-marketplace.md): Deploy Voyage AI embedding and reranking models using AWS Marketplace model packages in your AWS account and VPC with SageMaker.
- [Deploy Voyage AI Models Using Azure Marketplace](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/azure-marketplace.md): Deploy Voyage AI embedding and reranking models as real-time inference API endpoints in your Azure virtual network using Azure managed applications.
- [Manage Billing for the Embedding and Reranking API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/billing.md): Manage billing settings, view invoices and costs, and configure payment methods for your Voyage AI models in the Atlas UI.
- [Deploy Voyage AI Models Using Google Cloud Model Garden](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/gcp-marketplace.md): Deploy Voyage AI embedding models from Google Cloud Model Garden to Vertex AI endpoints with managed deployment and infrastructure.
- [Monitor Usage](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/monitor-usage.md): Monitor API key usage for Voyage AI models in the Atlas UI.
- [Organization and Project Access](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/organization-project-access.md): Learn about organization and project access for managing model API Keys in Atlas.
- [Manage Rate Limits](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/rate-limits.md): Use the Atlas UI to set and manage rate limits for API access.
- [Models Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models.md)
- [Contextualized Chunk Embeddings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models/contextualized-chunk-embeddings.md): Learn about Voyage AI's contextualized chunk embedding models for improved retrieval accuracy.
- [Multimodal Embeddings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models/multimodal-embeddings.md): Learn about Voyage AI's multimodal embedding models for text, image, and video retrieval.
- [Rerankers](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models/rerankers.md): Learn about Voyage AI's reranking models for refining search results and improving relevance.
- [Text Embeddings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models/text-embeddings.md): Learn about Voyage AI's text embedding models for semantic search and retrieval applications.
- [Voyage AI Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/quickstart.md)
- [Flexible Dimensions and Quantization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/tutorials/dimensions-and-quantization.md)
- [Migrate Your Applications to use the Atlas Embedding and Reranking API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/tutorials/migrate-to-atlas.md)
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Voyage AI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/tutorials/rag.md)
- [Semantic Search with Voyage AI Embeddings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/tutorials/semantic-search.md): Learn how to use Voyage AI embeddings for semantic search.
- [Tokenization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/tutorials/tokenization.md)
